title: Surreal Cinema Dream
description: A woman in a blue dress and grey jacket sits in a red velvet theater seat, projecting a beam of light from her eyes onto a massive surreal scene. The projected image shows an ornate flooded ballroom with floating picture frames, a pocket watch, ghostly figures, a silhouetted man on a ladder, and the numbers 3 2 4 1 visible on the floor.
prompt: A woman sitting in an old red velvet theater seat projecting a beam of light from her eyes into a giant surreal painting. The painting depicts a flooded elegant ballroom with floating golden picture frames, a giant pocket watch held by a hand, ghostly dancing figures, a silhouetted man climbing a ladder into the sky, and the numbers 3 2 4 1 on the floor. Dramatic cinematic lighting, sparks and embers floating, twilight sky in background, highly detailed surreal scene.
